app.name: Sigo
app.disclaimer: Sigo is not medical advice. Talk to your doctor before starting a new exercise program.

today.title: Today
today.placeholder: Your workout for today will show up here. Coming soon!

pain.title: Pain
pain.placeholder: Here you will tell us where it hurts, so we can protect that area.

profile.title: Profile
profile.seatedOnlyHint: Helpful if you feel unsteady standing.

reason.seatedVersion: It's the seated version: same work, less load.
reason.gentlerVersion: It's a gentler version of the same movement.
reason.avoidsArea: This one keeps the load off the area that hurts.
reason.mobility: For now, a gentle movement to loosen up.

bodyMap.caption: The figure is seen from behind: your left side is on the left.

doctorNotice.title: Please talk to your doctor before starting
doctorNotice.body: You can keep going, it's your decision. We'll start with gentle, seated exercises, and you can change that later in Profile.

painNotice.title: Please talk to your doctor before starting
painNotice.body: Very strong or sharp pain is worth showing to a doctor. You can keep going: we'll avoid exercises that load that area.

welcome.title: Welcome to Sigo
welcome.body: Gentle exercise at home that adapts to your discomfort. All you need is a sturdy chair.

disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.body: If something hurts a lot, stop and rest. If you feel chest pain, dizziness or shortness of breath, stop and call 911.

screening.title: A few quick questions
screening.intro: Take your time. This helps us keep you safe.

painWhere.title: Where does it hurt?
painWhere.hint: Tap the figure or pick from the list. You can mark more than one area.

equipment.title: What do you have at home?
equipment.hint: Check what you have. A sturdy chair is enough to start.

ready.title: You're all set, {{name}}!
ready.body: Today's workout is waiting for you. Go at your own pace.

tips.water: Keep water nearby and take sips.
tips.chair: Use a sturdy chair without wheels, placed against a wall.
tips.redFlags: If you feel chest pain, dizziness or shortness of breath, stop and call 911.
tips.pain: Mild discomfort is OK. If the pain is sharp or very strong, stop.
tips.breathe: Keep breathing during every exercise. Don't hold your breath.
